q: What is the correct order of steps to make tea?  -1 Pour water  -2 Turn on the kettle  -3 Add tea -4 Pour boiling water
If a program executes commands strictly in order, this is called:
What is the correct order of steps to make a sandwich? -Take bread  -Slice the bread  -Put filling  -Cover with the second slice
o: A) Take bread → Put filling → Slice the bread → Cover with the second slice
B) Take bread → Slice the bread → Put filling → Cover with the second slice
C) Put filling → Take bread → Slice the bread → Cover with the second slice
D) Slice the bread → Take bread → Put filling → Cover with the second slice

q: If a program performs the same action several times, this is called:
What is the correct order of actions to turn on a computer? -Connect the power  -Turn on the monitor  -Press the power button  -Wait for the system to boot
o: A) Press the power button → Connect the power → Turn on the monitor → Wait for the system to boot
B) Connect the power → Turn on the monitor → Press the power button → Wait for the system to boot
C) Connect the power → Press the power button → Wait for the system to boot → Turn on the monitor
D) Turn on the monitor → Connect the power → Press the power button → Wait for the system to boot
